summary: Edit r1: decoder cross-attention head 0 (model.decoder.layers.0.multihead_attn.head 0) x0, encoder layer 3 self-attention head 3 x0, encoder layer 0 self-attention head 6 x2 (3 heads). It does NOT pass the validation rule: on the 500 validation seeds (original strict success 9.0%, 455 strict failures) it fixed 63 and broke 24 (strict gain +7.8 points, share of failures removed 0.086 against the bar of 0.25, exact McNemar p 3.5e-05). Benchmark success rose +11.0 points. The stop rule applies: the candidate with the largest pooled net gain is frozen as a miss and the test decides. edit.json states this (passes_validation_rule false, stop_rule_used true).

Chosen by the rule committed in awe/candidates_ins.py before any validation rollout (stage3/choice.json). 8 of the 10 allowed validation checks used; the remaining 2 and 6,616 agent rollouts are left unused (DEVIATIONS.md, 2026-11-25). r1 ties with c06 at a pooled net of 145 and won the tie by fewer broken seeds; r2 had the larger validation gain (+8.2 against +7.8 points). On validation the candidates are not distinguishable (r1 against c06: 34 to 30, p 0.71; against r2: 31 to 33, p 0.90; scratch/ins_paired_candidates.py).

Best simple baseline on the same 500 seeds: constant offset off_j1_p0.04, +4.8 points (54 fixed, 30 broken, p 0.012). r1 against it, paired: 60 seeds only r1, 45 only the offset, exact p 0.17, so r1 is not shown to beat it. Other baselines on validation: late shift +2.8 (p 0.07), deviation gain -1.2, chunk 50 -2.2. The winning deviation-gain setting (0.8) is the lowest gain of its grid, and the winning late shift (0.02) is the smaller of its two steps; neither family was refined after the fixed grids. The constant offset winner (0.04 rad on joint 1) is interior to its grid (0.01 to 0.08).

The written hypothesis (verbatim from hypotheses.md, validation round, written before any validation rollout: the two heads slow the approach) is only partly supported. For: median step of the first pin contact 340 to 325, late-pin share 0.121 to 0.065, 84 of 154 pin contacts became strict successes against 45 of 99, benchmark +11.0. Against: the tracking number (median peg-tip offset before contact) got worse, 1.63 to 1.85 cm over the 296 and 313 episodes that meet, and the single heads' dose response does not move the tracking number in step (dial flags false). The atlas numbers of the edited heads (edit.json, atlas_of_the_edited_heads) do not test the timing story. No mechanism is claimed.

The auto-greedy edit (cross.h0 x0 with enc3.h3 x0, 70 fixed, 14 broken on its 450 search seeds) IS the agent's candidate c06, op for op, trajectory hashes equal on 450 of 450 search seeds. c06's design and validation results (+11.0 and +7.0 points) were known to the agent before the search was run, and the search's pool contains the three heads of r1. It is not an independent no-LLM result and the report must not describe it as one. The relation, computed from the files, is in freeze/autogreedy.json (relation_to_agent_candidates). r1 and this arm differ by one head (enc0.h6 x2).

Random rule and seed committed in e21e673 (2026-11-25) before any random edit ran; 40 draws of 343 matched edits. Dose arms: dial k in (0.5, -0.5, -1, -2), scale = max(0, 1 + k (s - 1)), decided before the validation results and recorded in DEVIATIONS.md (2026-11-25); one dose arm (k 0.5) lies between the original and the edit (k 1), the other three are on the reverse side, and at k -1 and -2 enc0.h6 is at x0 in both. The dose arms and random arms first ran in the session 27 smoke test on 3 design seeds (no decision used them).

Arms reproduce their earlier rows: 9 reference checks on 3 design seeds all match trajectory hashes (stage3/smoke_compare.json), agent_edit and one baseline also match from a clean copy of the commit (freeze_clean_copy), the export of the edit is byte-identical twice, tensor_diff gives 3 changed tensors (98,304 weights, 0.287% of inference weights), 15 tests pass. Reference: PROGRESS.md session 27.
Budgets at request: agent 93,384 of 100,000, baselines 46,812 of 50,000, auto-greedy 8,550 of 10,000, validation checks 8 of 10.
